angellovaalmonica.name: Angello Vaalmonica
angellovaalmonica.desc:
[ Pendulum Effect ] 
Each time you gain LP while you control a Fiend Monster Card in your other Pendulum Zone, place 1 Resonance Counter on this card. Once per turn, when an opponent's monster declares an attack, you can: Immediately after this effect resolves, Link Summon 1 "Vaalmonica" Link Monster.

[ Monster Effect ] 
If this card is in your hand: You can discard 1 other card; take 1 "Dimonno Vaalmonica" from your Deck, and place this card and that card in your Pendulum Zones. During your Main Phase, if this card was Normal or Special Summoned this turn: You can banish 1 "Vaalmonica" Normal Spell/Trap from your GY; apply whichever effect on that card includes gaining LP. You can only use each effect of "Angello Vaalmonica" once per turn.

brokenline.name: Broken Line
brokenline.desc: When a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect, is activated in this card's column, while this card is Set: Negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card.

centurionbonds.name: Centur-Ion Bonds
centurionbonds.desc: Place 1 "Centur-Ion" monster from your hand or GY in your Spell & Trap Zone as a face-up Continuous Trap. If a "Centur-Ion" Synchro Monster(s) is Special Summoned to your field, while this card is in your GY (except during the Damage Step): You can banish this card, then target 1 "Centur-Ion" monster in your GY; place it in your Spell & Trap Zone as a face-up Continuous Trap. You can only use each effect of "Centur-Ion Bonds" once per turn.

dinomistcharge.name: Dinomist Charge
dinomistcharge.desc: When this card is activated: Add 1 "Dinomist" monster from your Deck to your hand. Once per turn, if a "Dinomist" card(s) is added from the field to your Extra Deck face-up: Add 1 of those cards to your hand. You can only activate 1 "Dinomist Charge" per turn.

dnatransplant.name: DNA Transplant
dnatransplant.desc: Activate by declaring 1 monster Attribute. All face-up monsters become that Attribute.

doabarrelroll.name: Do a Barrel Roll
doabarrelroll.desc: When a Spell Card, Trap Card, or monster effect is activated: Tribute all "Mecha Phantom Beast Tokens" you control; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

earthboundrelease.name: Earthbound Release
earthboundrelease.desc: When a Level 6 or higher monster(s) is Normal or Special Summoned: Tribute 1 Level 10 "Earthbound" monster; destroy as many monsters your opponent controls as possible, and if you do, inflict damage to your opponent equal to the combined original ATK of those destroyed monster(s).

elphase.name: Elphase
elphase.desc:
2 Level 3 or higher Cyberse monsters
Gains 300 ATK for each monster this card points to. If this Link Summoned card leaves the field: You can target 1 Level 4 or lower Cyberse monster in your GY; Special Summon it, but for the rest of this turn, its effects (if any) are negated and it cannot be used as Link Material. You can only use this effect of "Elphase" once per turn.

gaiadraketheuniversalforce.name: Gaia Drake, the Universal Force
gaiadraketheuniversalforce.desc:
1 "Gaia Knight, the Force of Earth" + 1 non-Effect Synchro Monster
This card cannot be targeted by, or destroyed by, the effects of Effect Monsters.

ghostrickfairy.name: Ghostrick Fairy
ghostrickfairy.desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned, unless you control a "Ghostrick" monster. Once per turn: You can change this card to face-down Defense Position. When this card is flipped face-up: You can target 1 "Ghostrick" card in your GY; Set that card (but banish it when it leaves the field), then, you can change face-up monsters your opponent controls to face-down Defense Position, up to the number of Set cards you control.

golgoil.name: Golgoil
golgoil.desc: An iron giant that appears from a dimensional rift.

hiddenvillageofninjitsuarts.name: Hidden Village of Ninjitsu Arts
hiddenvillageofninjitsuarts.desc: If a "Ninja" monster is Summoned to your field: You can target 1 "Ninja" monster or 1 "Ninjitsu Art" card in your GY; add it to your hand, but you cannot activate cards, or the effects of cards, with that name for the rest of this turn. If a "Ninja" monster(s) or "Ninjitsu Art" card(s) you control would be destroyed by battle or an opponent's card effect, you can banish 1 "Ninja" monster from your GY instead. You can only use each effect of "Hidden Village of Ninjitsu Arts" once per turn.

instantfusion.name: Instant Fusion
instantfusion.desc: Pay 1000 LP; Special Summon 1 Level 5 or lower Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, but it cannot attack, also it is destroyed during the End Phase. (This is treated as a Fusion Summon.) You can only activate 1 "Instant Fusion" per turn.

lavaljudgmentlord.name: Laval Judgment Lord
lavaljudgmentlord.desc: Once per turn: You can banish 1 "Laval" monster from your Graveyard; inflict 1000 damage to your opponent. "Laval Judgment Lord" cannot declare an attack the turn this effect is activated.

machinametalcruncher.name: Machina Metalcruncher
machinametalcruncher.desc: If you control no face-up cards, you can Normal Summon this card without Tributing, but its original ATK becomes 1800. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can reveal 3 EARTH Machine monsters from your Deck, then your opponent randomly adds 1 of them to your hand, and you shuffle the rest back into your Deck. You can only use this effect of "Machina Metalcruncher" once per turn.

malicedollofdemise.name: Malice Doll of Demise
malicedollofdemise.desc: During your next Standby Phase after this card was sent from the field to the Graveyard by the effect of a Continuous Spell Card: Special Summon this card from the Graveyard.

mentaltuner.name: Mental Tuner
mentaltuner.desc:
You can activate 1 of these effects;
● Banish up to 1 LIGHT and up to 1 DARK monster from your hand and/or GY; increase or decrease this card's Level by the exact number banished, until the end of this turn.
● Target up to 2 of your banished monsters (1 LIGHT and/or 1 DARK); return them to the GY, and if you do, increase or decrease this card's Level by the exact number returned, until the end of this turn.
You can only use this effect of "Mental Tuner" once per turn.

number69heraldrycrestshatterstream.name: Number 69: Heraldry Crest - Shatter Stream
number69heraldrycrestshatterstream.desc:
4 Level 4 monsters
You can also Xyz Summon this card by using a monster you control whose original name is "Number 69: Heraldry Crest". (Transfer its materials to this card.) When your opponent activates a monster effect on the field, or an opponent's monster declares an attack (Quick Effect): You can Special Summon from your Extra Deck, 1 "Number 69: Heraldry Crest - Dark Matter Demolition" by using this face-up card you control as material, then destroy that opponent's monster. (This is treated as an Xyz Summon. Transfer this card's materials.) You can only use this effect of "Number 69: Heraldry Crest - Shatter Stream" once per turn.

orcustratedbabel.name: Orcustrated Babel
orcustratedbabel.desc: You can activate the effects of "Orcust" monsters in your GY, or of Link Monsters you control with "Orcust" in their original names, as Quick Effects. During your Main Phase, if this card is in your GY, except the turn it was sent to the GY: You can send 1 card from your hand to the GY; add this card to your hand.

performapaloddeyesminitaurus.name: Performapal Odd-Eyes Minitaurus
performapaloddeyesminitaurus.desc:
[ Pendulum Effect ] 
If your "Performapal" or "Odd-Eyes" monster attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.

[ Monster Effect ] 
During damage calculation, if your Pendulum Monster attacks an opponent's monster: You can make that opponent's monster lose 100 ATK for each "Performapal" and "Odd-Eyes" card you control, during damage calculation only.

plantfoodchain.name: Plant Food Chain
plantfoodchain.desc: Target 1 Plant-Type monster you control; equip this card to that target. It gains 500 ATK. If this card is destroyed by a card effect while equipped: You can target 1 Plant-Type monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target.

reeshaddollwendikurhu.name: Reeshaddoll Wendikurhu
reeshaddollwendikurhu.desc:
1 "Shaddoll" monster + 1 WIND monster
Must first be Fusion Summoned. (Quick Effect): You can change any number of face-down monsters on the field to face-up Defense Position, then you can change other face-up monsters on the field to face-down Defense Position up to the number of Flip monsters flipped face-up. You can only use this effect of "Reeshaddoll Wendikurhu" once per turn. If this card is sent to the GY: You can target 1 "Shaddoll" card in your GY; add it to your hand.

reptiliannelamia.name: Reptilianne Lamia
reptiliannelamia.desc: If this card is in your hand and all monsters you control are face-up Reptile monsters (min. 1): You can target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; change its ATK to 0, and if you do, Special Summon this card, then take damage equal to that monster's original ATK. If this card is sent to the GY as Synchro Material: You can target up to 2 face-up monsters on the field; change their ATK to 0. You can only use 1 "Reptilianne Lamia" effect per turn, and only once that turn.

rookiefurhire.name: Rookie Fur Hire
rookiefurhire.desc: Tribute 1 monster; Special Summon 1 monster "Fur Hire" from your hand or Deck, whose Level is 1 higher or 1 lower than the Tributed monster had on the field. You cannot declare attacks the turn you activate this card, except with monsters "Fur Hire". You can only activate 1 "Rookie Fur Hire" per turn.

secretsofthegallant.name: Secrets of the Gallant
secretsofthegallant.desc: Select 1 Normal Monster you control. When the selected monster inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent this turn, your opponent discards 2 random cards.

stareater.name: Star Eater
stareater.desc:
1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
Must be Synchro Summoned, and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. This card's Synchro Summon cannot be negated. When Synchro Summoned, cards and effects cannot be activated. If this card attacks, it is unaffected by other card effects until the end of the Damage Step.

swordsoulemergence.name: Swordsoul Emergence
swordsoulemergence.desc: Add 1 "Swordsoul" monster from your Deck to your hand, or if you control a Synchro Monster, you can add 1 Wyrm monster instead. If this card is banished: You can target 1 "Swordsoul" monster, or Wyrm monster, you control; increase or decrease its Level by 1 until the end of this turn. You can only use each effect of "Swordsoul Emergence" once per turn.

theendofanubis.name: The End of Anubis
theendofanubis.desc: While this card is face-up on the field, all effects of Spell, Trap, and Monster Cards that target a card(s) in the Graveyard or that activate in the Graveyard are negated.

thewanderingdoomed.name: The Wandering Doomed
thewanderingdoomed.desc: ''A monster that wanders the edges of the netherworld.''

tokenstampede.name: Token Stampede
tokenstampede.desc: All Tokens in Attack Position gain 1000 ATK, also they cannot be destroyed by battle.

tornadobird.name: Tornado Bird
tornadobird.desc: FLIP: Return 2 Spell or Trap Cards on the field to their owners' hands.

verdantsanctuary.name: Verdant Sanctuary
verdantsanctuary.desc: When a face-up Insect monster is destroyed by battle or card effect and sent to the GY: Its controller can add 1 Insect monster with the same Level as the destroyed monster from their Deck to their hand.

visionherotrinity.name: Vision HERO Trinity
visionherotrinity.desc:
3 "HERO" monsters
After this card is Fusion Summoned, for the rest of this turn, this card's ATK becomes double its original ATK. This Fusion Summoned card can make a second and third attack during each Battle Phase. Cannot attack directly.

yellowduston.name: Yellow Duston
yellowduston.desc: Cannot be used as a Fusion, Synchro, or Xyz Material for a Summon. While this card is face-up on the field, it cannot be Tributed. When this card on the field is destroyed: The controller targets 1 monster in their Graveyard; shuffle that target into the Deck. You can only control 1 face-up "Yellow Duston".
